journal_lines: Herd moving through the open ground. Large. Patient work, good return.
Migration through the plains. Took what we needed from the stragglers.
The whole valley moving at once. Picked carefully. Plenty to choose from.
Seasonal herd. Right place, right time. Good hunt.
The grass moved before the herd did. Then the herd. Then the grass again, behind them.
Took only what could be carried. The herd will be more numerous next season. They always are.
Followed the herd from a long way off for a long time. They knew. They moved on.
Dust on the horizon all morning. The dust had four legs each, mostly.
